guidance.bestFor: The bare default at its built-in 16px size, with no props and no text beside it

whenNotToUse.when: A wait that needs a few words beside it saying what is loading

guidance.bestFor: Leading spinners in a live primary, a disabled outline and a square icon only button with its own label
agentNotes: The Processing `Button` is not `disabled`, so it stays clickable while it spins; lock it from your pending flag
`data-icon` inline-start on the `Spinner` in each labelled `Button` trims that button's leading padding to fit the icon

whenNotToUse.when: A save action that cycles idle, saving and saved after one click

guidance.bestFor: Status labels in primary, secondary and outline plus light destructive, success and info tints, each led by a spinner
agentNotes: `Badge` here is the ReUI primitive; the shadcn badge has no `destructive-light`, `success-light` or `info-light` variant

guidance.bestFor: A search field under a Searching label, its spinner shown in a leading addon before the typed text
agentNotes: `FieldLabel` points `htmlFor` at the `InputGroup` wrapper, not the input; move the `id` to `InputGroupInput` so the label names the field
`InputGroupAddon` has no align set, so it takes the inline start slot and the spinner leads the field despite its markup order

whenNotToUse.when: A locked field that keeps its value while a check turns at its end

guidance.bestFor: A centered loading view with the spinner in a muted tile, a Loading projects heading and a Cancel action
agentNotes: The Cancel `Button` is `disabled` and has no handler; enable it and abort the running request from it

whenNotToUse.when: A view with no records yet that invites the first one to be added

guidance.bestFor: Disabled default, outline and secondary buttons, each pairing a spinner with a pending word like Saving

whenNotToUse.when: An icon only square control with no words beside the indicator
A save action that moves to saving then saved on its own after one click

guidance.bestFor: A blurred translucent cover with a Refreshing data caption laid over a monthly report card's figures
agentNotes: The overlay `Card` is `absolute` with `inset-0`, but its wrapper div is not positioned; add relative there or it covers the nearest positioned ancestor

whenNotToUse.when: A bare cover with no caption, positioned by the card it sits in

guidance.bestFor: A standalone card with a faded spinner above a setup message and a smaller muted hint
agentNotes: The `Card` is held to `max-w-xs` and a 200px minimum height; widen it and center it in the viewport for a whole page load

whenNotToUse.when: Content of a known shape that should keep its layout while it loads

guidance.bestFor: Stacked status lines with 14px spinners, 2 tinted by the success and warning tokens for connected and reconnecting

whenNotToUse.when: A wait that hides the content it is refreshing behind a blurred cover

guidance.bestFor: A row of 3 dots that bounce on staggered delays, drawn as plain spans in the primary color, with no icon
agentNotes: The dots are bare `span` elements with no status role or label, so screen readers hear nothing; give the wrapper both

whenNotToUse.when: A rotating icon that announces itself to screen readers as loading

guidance.bestFor: A blurred cover holding only a spinner, nested inside the card it hides, with no caption

whenNotToUse.when: A cover that also tells the reader what is loading in a short line

guidance.bestFor: A row of 5 spinners at 16px, tinted blue, green, red, yellow and purple through text color classes
agentNotes: The 5 tints are fixed palette classes such as `text-blue-500` that ignore your theme; swap in your own color tokens

whenNotToUse.when: Tints drawn from the theme's success and warning tokens beside status words
